similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the Texas State Capitol building. It features a symmetrical layout with a prominent central dome, multi-tiered drum, portico, and flanking wings. The dome is modeled using a combination of polygonal prisms, conical frustums, and a dome top, with the lantern and statue on top. The wings are constructed with precise window grids, and the rooflines are sloped correctly outwards. All parts are tightly integrated to prevent gaps, and the rear facade is mirrored to ensure a complete 360-degree structure.
